title: Copilot video creation in Clipchamp Video Hub is now live in Frontier Public
summary: Copilot video creation in Clipchamp Video Hub is now in public preview, enabling users to create and refine videos from documents and prompts using Copilot Credits. Admins must enable Anthropic models and configure spending policies. Videos export as MP4 with an AI watermark, and some preview limitations apply.
body:
[What and Why:]

Copilot video creation is coming to the Clipchamp Video Hub. It turns documents, ideas and work content into videos that make complex information easier to understand and act on. Users start with a prompt, a document from OneDrive, or relevant work context, then preview the video in chat and refine it through conversation until they’re happy with it.

This is a usage-based billing (UBB) feature. Each video and subsequent refinements use Copilot Credits, billed through Copilot Credits usage-based billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center. To enable access, admins must enable Anthropic models and configure Copilot Credits spending policies for intended users.

Key features:

- Create from a prompt. Describe the topic, audience, tone and length, or pick a starter prompt. - Create in your language. Describe the video in your preferred language and make localized content for audiences worldwide. - Base videos on your content. Add a Word document, PowerPoint presentation, images, video or PDF from OneDrive, or draw on relevant work context through Work IQ. - Refine through conversation. Ask for changes like "Use a more formal tone", "Make it shorter", "Localize this into Japanese" or "Update the title." - Preview in chat. Watch each version without leaving the experience. - Export and share. Save the finished video as an MP4. 

How to get started: 

Admins first turn on Copilot video creation in a spending policy that includes the right users, in Copilot > Cost management in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

Users can then:

- Open Clipchamp Video Hub - [CompanyName].sharepoint.com/_layouts/15/videohub.aspx?vhnav=video-agent-home- Go to Create video in the left menu- Describe the video, and add files if needed.- Preview the video, refine it.- Select Export to save it as an MP4.

[Rollout Schedule:]

Public Preview (Frontier public): available as of November 17, 2026.

General Availability (Worldwide): Expected February (timing subject to final confirmation).

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Users included in eligible spending policies can create and refine videos from work content in Clipchamp Video Hub. Video creation and refinements consume Copilot Credits and appear in Copilot cost management reporting. 

Governance:

- Exported videos carry a "Made with AI" watermark, which admins can turn off. - Videos only draw on work content the user already has access to.

Known limitations at preview:

- Sensitivity labels: Videos created from documents with a sensitivity label above General can't be downloaded yet but can be viewed.- Availability: Anthropic models must be enabled for your organization. If they're turned off, video creation isn't available.- Generation: Creating and changing videos can take some time. Requests may sometimes fail or time out, and preview or playback may not work as expected.- Editing: Changes happen through conversation, and videos export as MP4. Editing individual scenes or elements in Clipchamp isn't supported yet.- Source material: WorkIQ, Web search, Word, PowerPoint, images (up to 3 per prompt), Videos (under 50mb) and PDF are supported. More file types and multiple sources will come in future releases.- Sessions: Keep the browser tab open while a video is being created. Only one session at a time is supported.

[Action Required/Recommendations:]

If you plan to enable this capability, confirm Anthropic models are enabled and update Copilot Credits spending policies to include Copilot video creation with Clipchamp for intended users.

Review internal readiness guidance for admins and support teams before broader enablement.

[Compliance considerations:]

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.
